codeReview.summary: The fix moves one clip preflight ahead of atlas lookup and adds a focused regression, but the new preflight rectangle is still only the padded raster-target bounds, not the final cropped glyph bounds. That means a clip can intersect the preflight padding while still excluding the real glyph, so the atlas can still be rasterized and dirtied before the later exact `glyphRect` check rejects emission.

issues.description: The new `nativeGlyphPreflightRect` gate is not tight enough to satisfy the original blocker. `appendNativeTextGlyphs` now skips atlas lookup only when the clip misses the padded preflight rect (`ScenePainter.swift:720-729` and `783-796`), but that rect is built from `makeCapturedGlyphRasterMetrics`'s full render-target size plus padding (`DirectWriteTextRenderer.swift:85-124`), not from the final cropped glyph bounds. The atlas entry is still cropped afterward (`DirectWriteTextRenderer.swift:580-593`, `1081-1130`), and the real glyph visibility test still happens only after `NativeGlyphAtlas.shared.glyph(...)` returns (`ScenePainter.swift:729-750`). So a clip that intersects only the preflight padding/blank target area will still rasterize and insert the atlas entry even though the final `glyphRect` is fully clipped and emitted nowhere. That leaves the prior VAL-TEXT-010 blocker unresolved for those native-path cases.

summary: Reviewed the prior failed review, the original and fix feature handoffs/transcript skeletons, the graphics-scene skill, mission shared-state docs, and commit `02bb6a44f080eb3e51d1ef8355376d2b52186710`. The fix improves the native-path clip check, but it still allows atlas writes when only the padded preflight bounds intersect the clip, so the original blocking issue is not fully resolved.
